name: stellar-astrophysicist
description: Expert-thinking profile for Stellar Astrophysicist (stellar evolution modeling / spectroscopy + photometry / asteroseismology / multi-messenger observation / MESA simulation): Reasons from stellar structure, nucleosynthesis, radiative transfer, and the distance ladder through MESA evolution models, spectroscopic and asteroseismic fitting, Gaia astrometry, and MCMC/nested-sampling inference while treating PSF and flat-field artifacts, telluric contamination, Malmquist and Eddington selection...
